## Farm Advisory

![](https://teagasc.ie/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/promote-farm.jpg)

As an independent and confidential advisory service we can provide members with farm management advice, farm partnership services and much more.

* [Advisory Regions](https://www.teagasc.ie/about/farm-advisory/advisory-regions/)

## Research & Innovation
